fact: The shell which hashed the 198 MB of UTF-8 wrappers was still running after the initial one-second exec yield. A dependent cat was attempted before PUBLISH-LIST.json existed, and JSON.parse rejected its cat error text. The actual shell was then waited to terminal exit 0 before any Git publication.
fix: Await the existing yielded shell session; then inspect each exit code and complete JSON before initializing the publisher.
